sources.role: config/save/state/bios paths and TOML keys; same pin as the Lunchbox controller contract
BIOS/firmware filenames and sizes, DSi-mode dumps, savestate slots alongside ROM
Lunchbox pinned contract: melonDS.toml Instance0.Joystick buttons and JoystickID

paths.naming: Controller TOML syntax: `Instance0.Joystick.<Btn>` for A/B/Select/Start/Right/Left/Up/Down/R/L/X/Y, `Instance0.JoystickID` for the SDL device index, and `Joystick.HK_*` for hotkeys
paths.path: ~/.config/melonDS/melonDS.toml (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/melonDS/); a directory named 'portable' next to the executable overrides this. melonDS.ini (0.9.x and earlier) is auto-loaded and migrated to melonDS.toml at 1.0+. Controllers: TOML keys Instance0.Joystick.<Btn> for the twelve DS buttons (A, B, Select, Start, Right, Left, Up, Down, R, L, X, Y) plus Instance0.JoystickID (SDL device index) and Joystick.HK_* hotkey bindings
evidence: source:melonDS src/frontend/qt_sdl/main.cpp pathInit (QStandardPaths::ConfigLocation + mkdir "melonDS"; 'portable' dir check) @906e9eb
source:melonDS src/frontend/qt_sdl/Config.cpp Joy_A..Joy_Y, JoystickID, HKJoy_* keys @906e9eb

paths.path: ~/.config/melonDS/melonDS.toml (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/melonDS/, with portable/ beside the executable taking precedence); DS mappings are Instance0.Joystick.<Btn>, Instance0.JoystickID, and Joystick.HK_*
paths.naming: TOML values encode the twelve DS buttons (A, B, Select, Start, Right, Left, Up, Down, R, L, X, Y), SDL joystick device index, and hotkey bindings; the physical device is selected through the SDL runtime
evidence: source:melonDS src/frontend/qt_sdl/Config.cpp Joy_A..Joy_Y, JoystickID, HKJoy_* keys @906e9eb
source:melonDS src/frontend/qt_sdl/main.cpp pathInit config and portable-directory selection @906e9eb

paths.path: Alongside the ROM by default: <ROM basename>.sav (DS and GBA-slot saves); the SaveFilePath key in melonDS.toml redirects all saves to one directory; secondary instances append an instance suffix to the filename
paths.naming: <ROM basename>.sav next to the ROM (or <SaveFilePath>/<ROM basename>.sav); .dsv is the pre-0.9.3 legacy extension and only appears in the import dialog filter (*.sav *.bin *.dsv), not in current saves
evidence: source:melonDS 0.9.3 src/frontend/qt_sdl/main.cpp already builds completeBaseName() + ".sav" (.dsv predates 0.9.3)

paths.path: Alongside the ROM by default; the SavestatePath key in melonDS.toml redirects savestates to one directory; slots 1-8 via Shift+F1..F8 (save) / F1..F8 (load)
paths.naming: <ROM basename>.ml1 .. <ROM basename>.ml8 (extension is ".ml" + slot digit; no-ROM/firmware states use firmware.mlN; the file dialog filter is *.mln)
evidence: source:melonDS src/frontend/qt_sdl/Window.cpp save/load state menus create slots 1..8 and "File..." with *.mln filter @906e9eb
docs:melonDS FAQ (savestates for slots 1..8 placed alongside the ROM)

paths.path: Optional. Emu.ExternalBIOSEnable gates DS.BIOS9Path / DS.BIOS7Path / DS.FirmwarePath (bios9.bin 4KB, bios7.bin 16KB, firmware.bin 128-512KB); built-in FreeBIOS is the no-firmware fallback (also covers DSi TWL images at this pin). DSi mode additionally uses DSi.BIOS9Path / DSi.BIOS7Path / DSi.FirmwarePath / DSi.NANDPath. Wi-Fi settings live in wfcsettings.bin in the melonDS directory; the GBA slot needs no BIOS at this pin
paths.naming: DS dumps use bios9.bin (4 KiB), bios7.bin (16 KiB), and firmware.bin (128/256/512 KiB); DSi adds BIOS/firmware/NAND paths; FreeBIOS is the fallback and no canonical checksum is supplied
evidence: source:melonDS src/frontend/qt_sdl/Config.cpp ExternalBIOSEnable, DS.BIOS9Path/BIOS7Path/FirmwarePath, DSi.* keys @906e9eb
docs:melonDS FAQ (bios9.bin 4KB, bios7.bin 16KB, firmware.bin 128/256/512KB; DSi dumps)

paths.path: No external cryptographic key file
paths.naming: Not applicable.
evidence: source:melonDS @906e9eb (DS BIOS/firmware paths are ordinary dumps; no cryptographic-key file is defined)

paths.path: Next to melonDS.exe in official builds (CMake PORTABLE option defaults ON -> WIN32_PORTABLE, emuDirectory = executable directory); a 'portable' directory next to the exe is also honored; non-portable builds fall back to %LOCALAPPDATA%\melonDS (Qt ConfigLocation maps to FOLDERID_LocalAppData). melonDS.toml since 1.0, melonDS.ini before
evidence: source:melonDS src/frontend/qt_sdl/CMakeLists.txt option(PORTABLE ... ON) -> WIN32_PORTABLE define @906e9eb
source:Qt qstandardpaths_win.cpp maps ConfigLocation to FOLDERID_LocalAppData
docs:melonDS GitHub issue #950 and kuribo64 board reports (config written beside melonDS.exe)
